panels.title: A1 - Weekly active users (distinct device_id)

targets.expr: count(count by (attributes_device_id) (count_over_time({service_name="lichtblick"} | json | body="Studio: App Initialized" [7d])))

panels.description: Distinct anonymous devices that started a session in the window. Loki lines are JSON, so the parser is | json (not logfmt) and the event name is the AppEvent text in `body`; device_id lives in the line body, never as a metric label.

panels.title: A2 - Session duration (p50/p95, derived from heartbeat)
panels.description: Per-session duration is a gauge refreshed on every heartbeat (no reliance on an end-of-session event). max_over_time gives how long each session reached within the range; quantile() then takes percentiles across sessions.

panels.title: A4 - Renderer heap (gauge, resolution <= 30s)
panels.description: Renderer JS heap. The `_bytes` suffix comes from the instrument's UCUM unit (By) declared in eventRouting.ts METRIC_UNITS.

panels.title: A5 - Renderer gone, by reason
panels.description: Every abnormal renderer exit, grouped by reason — never filtered to reason="oom". A V8 heap OOM does not necessarily surface as "oom": an isolated probe on macOS reported reason="crashed" (exit code 5) for `V8 javascript OOM (Reached heap limit)`, and since StudioWindow runs with sandbox:false the renderer carries a Node environment, so the OOM can instead come through Node's handler. Filtering on a single reason silently hides the event we most care about.

panels.title: A6 - Interactions by panel type (last 7d)
panels.description: Interaction volume (pointerdown captured in the Panel HOC, see useInteractionCapture.ts), not just panel presence like A3 — a panel can be open all week and never be clicked.

panels.title: A7 - Top controls by target_id
panels.description: Ranked by the $panel_type template variable (defaults to all panels). Filtered to target_kind="control" so the ranking reflects annotated controls (see the taxonomy pilot, docs/telemetry/interaction-heatmap-poc-plan.md WS-4) rather than being dominated by target_id="unlabeled" panel-surface clicks, which the spatial heatmap (docs/telemetry/poc/heatmap/) covers instead.

panels.title: A8 - Least-used controls by target_id
panels.description: The bottom of the same ranking as A7 — the more actionable half of "where do users interact least", since a control that is never used is a candidate for simplification in a way a heavily-used one is not.

panels.title: A9 - Distinct devices per target (k-anonymity check)

targets.expr: topk(20, count by (attributes_target_id) (count by (attributes_target_id, attributes_device_id) (count_over_time({service_name="lichtblick"} | json | body="Studio: UI Interaction" [7d]))))

panels.description: Distinct anonymous devices behind each target_id, over the dashboard's 7d window. This is the k-anonymity threshold expressed as a query rather than promised in prose: WS-6 requires no drill-down below 5 distinct devices, so any bar at or below 5 here means that target_id's other panels (A7/A8, and the spatial heatmap) are not yet safe to show without further aggregation. Uses Loki (device_id is deliberately never a metric label, see METRIC_ATTRIBUTE_ALLOWLIST) so this is heavier than a Prometheus query — keep the time range short when iterating.
